concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-split-transactions-split-chargebacks]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace disputed-amount booking guide for liable/user/ratio options, capture-over-payment precedence, invalid-target liable fallback and split-grain webhook tracking; samples have currency/account/status inconsistencies.
warnings: A successful Checkout request does not verify destination balance accounts; nonexistent or closed-holder targets book the full transaction and fees to the liable account.

The ratio example mixes USD and EUR labels; webhook examples mismatch `event` versus `events` and some fee/commission account IDs and event-status labels. Preserve the prose-level lifecycle and verify live bookings separately.
